scope: new canonical-v2 Supertonic 3 INT8 ONNX/sherpa CPU Android benchmark

route.application_cpu_orchestration: sherpa frontend, generation control, callbacks and WAV encoding
route.state_reset: Each timed iteration is a separate OfflineTts.generateWithConfigAndCallback invocation; no cache/state tensors pass between calls and each returned Audio object is independent. Sessions remain created once.

measurement.timing_boundary: System.nanoTime around OfflineTts.generate only; WAV write/hash/listening excluded
measurement.rtf: generation seconds divided by each run's actual emitted audio duration
measurement.warm_headline: median of five warm per-run RTF values
measurement.structural_audio: every run must be valid finite non-silent unclipped PCM; retain all hashes and curate the warm-median run
measurement.listening: not_reviewed until explicit Moritz verdict for exact WAV hash

historical_boundary: This is a new canonical-v2 route. It does not overwrite or relabel legacy-v1 experiments 0008 or 0020.
